These queries come from the page alone and none has been run. The least certain parts are:
- `trim` is not listed, so K11 strips spaces with `split " " | join ""`.
- Map keys must be keywords, so grouped keys go through `keyword`.
- The `round` modifier is unknown, so rounding uses `mul`, `round` and `div`.

K1: ["Apple","banana","APPLE","Cherry","banana","date","Date","elderberry"] * lower | distinct | count
K2: filter ~(/status | eq "paid") | groupBy ~(/customer | keyword) * (/ * (at :total | coalesce 0) | sum)
K3: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (split " " | /1 | keyword) | groupBy ~(/) * count
K4: :dev /devDependencies | /dependencies | union dev | filter ~(startsWith "^") | keys * keyword | sort
K5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~([(at :comments | coalesce 0 | mul -1) /id]) | take 3 * /id
K6: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | drop 1 * split "," | filter ~(and (/2 | lower | eq "de") (/1 | ne "")) * (/1 | parseJson) | :v / | sum | div (v | count) | mul 10 | round | div 10
K7: /services | :s / | keys * (:k / | {:name (k | keyword) :svc (s | at k)}) | filter ~(and (/svc/enabled | eq true) (/svc | at :port | type | eq ::number)) | sort ~(/svc/port) * ([/name (/svc/port | print)] | join ":")
K8: /results | filter ~(and (at :email | coalesce "" | split "@" | last | lower | eq "example.com") (/user/name/last | type | ne ::null)) * ([/user/name/last /user/name/first] | join ", ")
K9: filter ~(and (/user | type | ne ::null) (/action | lower | eq "login")) * (/user | lower) | distinct | sort
K10: filter ~(at :salary | type | eq ::number) | groupBy ~(/dept | keyword) * (/ * /salary | :v / | sum | div (v | count) | mul 100 | round | div 100)
K11: / * (at :tags | coalesce "" | split "," * (split " " | join "" | lower) | filter ~(count | gt 0)) | flat | groupBy ~(/ | keyword) | :g / | keys * (:k / | {:tag (k | keyword) :n (g | at k)}) | sort ~([(/n | mul -1) /tag]) | take 3 * /tag
K12: lines | filter ~(and (startsWith "#" | not) (count | gt 0)) * (split "|" | :p / | /1 | parseJson | mul (p | /2 | parseJson)) | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100
K13: /services | filter ~(/env | lower | eq "prod") | every ~(at :replicas | coalesce 1 | gte 2)
K14: / * {:id /id :itemCount (at :items | coalesce [] * /qty | sum)} | filter ~(/itemCount | gt 0) | sort ~([(/itemCount | mul -1) /id]) | take 3
